test_title: PYST 67: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 27 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All caps are hats.

All caps are scarfs.

Some scarfs are mufflers.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some mufflers are caps.

(II) Some scarfs are hats.
solution:
**Statements:**

All caps are hats.**
All caps are scarfs.

Some scarfs are mufflers.

**Venn Diagram Logic:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83a001bedf92b5cf4f840617f246f457395601ab07e728ef6794b03146920fdf.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some mufflers are caps: Does not follows **(Because “Some scarfs are mufflers” does not guarantee that mufflers are caps.)

(II) Some scarfs are hats: **Follows **(Because all caps are both scarfs and hats. Therefore, at least some scarfs are hats.)

Therefore, only conclusion (II) follows.

**Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".**
